description:
Gerald Mitchell is back on Mother Tongue after the now classic “Another Day” with a new Los Hermanos EP, this time bringing it back to the origins with the Detroit Techno opus “Family”. Recorded in Tokyo with Ian O’Brien, this special extended version has Anthem written all over it. Also included is the futuristic tech funk of “Paradigm 4th Shifter” and the intergalactic beatless space jam “Far Beyond Sight”.

Another classic in the making..
